reviews.text: Wow! Smooth operator🎶. We decided to stay local with a need for auto body repair. Tim’s Body Shop was very fast in service, reasonable, and they even washed my car when they were done.
reviews.author: Kathy S.

reviews.text: Tim’s Body Shop did an excellent job for us twice on two different cars. First, they repaired a smashed in bumper a few years ago and most recently they repaired a passenger side mirror that had been badly damaged.
reviews.author: Shannon E.

reviews.text: Tims body shop did a awesome paint job on my car ...I would definitely recommend anyone that is looking for a number 1 paint shop to check these guys out ..Mike was very helpful and went the extra mile if I had any questions..Thanks
reviews.author: Jaden Z.
